records.source_headline: A resident of the Kherson region, who was attacked by a drone this morning, died in hospital.
records.where_description:
A 62-year-old woman who was injured in a Russian drone attack in Komyshany, Kherson region, died in the hospital this morning.
This was reported by the head of the Kherson MVA Yaroslav Shanko in  Telegram , Ukrinform reports.

"A 62-year-old woman, who was attacked by Russian terrorists from a drone in Komyshany at around 6.20, died despite all the efforts of doctors ," the report says.

Shanko noted that the victim was hospitalized with a mine-explosive injury, amputation of her left arm and leg, and shrapnel wounds to her torso.

records.source_original:
Ukraine (Russian troops attacked the Kherson region with drones, one person was killed and one was wounded .
As Ukrinform reports, the Kherson OVA reported this on Telegram .

It is noted that at about 2:00 p.m., Russian occupiers attacked the village of Virivka, Tyaginska community, with a drone. A 49-year-old man was hit by the enemy strike and sustained non-life-threatening injuries .

Also at approximately 3:20 p.m., Russians attacked a woman with a drone in the Dniprovs'kyi district of Kherson . The 72-year-old Kherson woman was taken to the hospital with an explosive injury and shrapnel wounds to her head and torso.

Read also: Two police officers injured in Kherson as a result of a second attack on a minibus
In addition, at around 3:00 p.m., Russian invaders struck Nova Kamianka, Mylivska community, with a drone. As a result of the enemy attack, a 67-year-old man suffered an explosive injury and shrapnel wounds to his legs.)
